CommandItem.description: One entry of the slash menu (slash.merge): the dashboard's own first, then Claude Code's.
CommandItem.title: CommandItem

ContextUsage.description: Tokens of the last main-thread call and the model's window.
ContextUsage.title: ContextUsage

Features.description: What this install has turned on, and how Claude Code is signed in (plan only).
Features.title: Features

HomeAwait.description: A note waiting for the owner's verdict (fact-checked with no human_verdict, or AI-curated and unreviewed).
HomeAwait.title: HomeAwait

HomeEvent.description: The home screen's notes part (home.summary): open tasks and recent notes in the vault.
HomeEvent.title: HomeEvent

HomeWatchEvent.description: The home screen's "don't forget" part (watch.summary): reminders, links, unsaved repos, open PRs, Vikunja tasks.
HomeWatchEvent.title: HomeWatchEvent

ItemDoneMsg.description: Archive: mark a Vikunja task done (done=False brings it back). The server answers with the new item_list.
ItemDoneMsg.title: ItemDoneMsg

ItemEvent.description: One item in full (items.get): chips, plain-text body, the repo it maps to (label, None = no repo), the prompt to copy.
ItemEvent.title: ItemEvent

ItemListEvent.description: One table (items.list_): its columns and rows. `group_key` is the column to group by ("repo" = the Repo column).
ItemListEvent.title: ItemListEvent

ItemStartMsg.description: Start in Orb: a new session in the item's repo (found by the server), first request = the brief.
ItemStartMsg.title: ItemStartMsg

RoutineItem.description: One row of the Routines panel (routines.item).
RoutineItem.title: RoutineItem

RoutineTaskMsg.description: "Make it a task": one line in the notes inbox pointing at this routine's last result.
RoutineTaskMsg.title: RoutineTaskMsg

RoutinesSeenMsg.description: Read a result: one routine (`id`), everything (`all`), or, with neither, whatever doesn't notify.
RoutinesSeenMsg.title: RoutinesSeenMsg

ScreenMsg.description: What the page shows now, as plain text; name None = the chat itself (nothing rides along).
ScreenMsg.title: ScreenMsg

SessionInfo.description: What agent.py keeps in FolderSession.info (from Claude Code's init message, then updated).
SessionInfo.title: SessionInfo

TaskChangedEvent.description: A task line was rewritten (tasks.act); `previous` is what Undo puts back.
TaskChangedEvent.title: TaskChangedEvent

TaskDetailEvent.description: One task in its note (tasks.detail): the line, the note's title and heading, the lines around it.
TaskDetailEvent.title: TaskDetailEvent

TaskInfo.description: One background task (an opus-coder run or a background shell), as agent.py keeps it.
TaskInfo.title: TaskInfo

UsageWindow.description: One plan window from the SDK's rate-limit info (unifiedWindows).
UsageWindow.title: UsageWindow

VaultInfo.description: The notes folder as the setup shows it: where, and what Orb found in it.
VaultInfo.title: VaultInfo
